identity.scope: same source bytes, parser name/version and sn1 policy; independent of path, crop, fallback BPM and canonical part mapping
identity.part_order: source MusicXML part order or pretty_midi nonempty instrument order; not raw MIDI track index
identity.event_order: full source events sorted stably by onset then concert MIDI pitch; zero-based per source part
identity.tie_policy: one ID per tie-merged pitched event, not per MusicXML segment
identity.chord_policy: one ID per chord pitch; duplicate unisons retain distinct ordinals
identity.grace_policy: MusicXML zero-duration grace notes omitted; no performed onset inferred
identity.revision_policy: source edits, parser upgrades or policy changes require new identities; no cross-revision matching
